title: Faithful exact degree-zero heart realization
statement: For a base X and rational realization a as in [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], the functor realize from the rational heart to continuous rational module sheaves [def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data] is faithful and preserves short exact sequences.

proof.text: Use the heart clause to identify every realized heart object with a single sheaf in degree zero. Conjugate maps by these isomorphisms. The single embedding is fully faithful and its H^0 is naturally the identity, so H^0 is injective on these maps. The fully faithful rational realization reflects equality.

Extend a short exact heart sequence to a distinguished triangle, then apply the triangulated realization. Its two t-bound clauses make degree -1 of the third term and degree 1 of the first term zero. The homology long exact sequence gives mono, exactness and epi at degree zero.
